changeSet.author: fund-transfer-bank-service

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name = 'banking_service'

changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS banking_service;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON SCHEMA banking_service TO "fund-transfer";
ALTER ROLE "fund-transfer" SET search_path TO banking_service, public;
changeSet.rollback: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS banking_service CASCADE;
